cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Soccer banana free-kicks, baseball curveballs/sliders, tennis topspin drops, golf backspin loft, and aircraft wing circulation trajectories
Computing transverse aerodynamic lift vector as F_Magnus = rho * cross(Gamma_vec, U_vec) so lateral swerve scales directly with spin angular velocity and airspeed
Visualizing asymmetric wake downwash and streamline crowding on the retreating/advancing sides of a spinning sphere
not_for: Vacuum lunar trajectories where air density rho = 0
Non-rotating knuckleballs governed by stochastic Karman vortex shedding rather than steady Magnus circulation
